about_the_game:
Welcome to your first semester at the Witch Academy!


Your task: Discover magical creatures — and complete the enchanted lexicon with everything you find.


There’s an old legend…

Deep within the enchanted forest, a mystical creature is said to dwell.

Perhaps you are the chosen one. The one who will witness it — or even tame it.

Grow your own magical garden. Nurture it with care — and let it bloom to attract the wild and wondrous beasts.

Your journey begins now.

This project was created by following SAE Zurich Students:

Creature Artist

Lara Stolz

Environment Artist

Tamryn Lazenby

Animation / Rigging

Lia Sennhauser

Programming

Enna Zubler, Alexander Hofer

Special thanks to following people:

Music

Joëlle Salomé Götz

Steam Artwork

Adrian Hofer

Testers

Peter Flück, Pascal Strähl, Luca Wüest, Lukas Hofer, Adrian Hofer, Ben Weber, Silas Brüellhardt, Ivo Gonçalves
